name: Tupuxuara
sum: Large thalassodromid with a big bony crest, from the Romualdo Formation of Brazil.
holotype: MN 6591-V (T. longicristatus) — Romualdo Formation, Araripe Basin.
material: Snout and partial wing bones (holotype); several skulls of T. leonardii.
biology: Long wings relative to body mass; the crest was mostly bone.
author: Kellner and Campos 1988
